integrity: Analytical proof is unrestricted. Exact rational sample checks are finite corroboration, not exhaustive mathematical verification.
scientific_limitations: Only finite Cartesian products of unweighted complete graphs with adjacency dynamics and Cesàro time averaging; no claim about other Hamiltonians or instantaneous mixing. Stronger general Cartesian-product or association-scheme formulas might imply the result.
title: Signed-frequency resonance and average-mixing rank in products of complete graphs
